title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・どでけえ好敵手よ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One pushes past her own limits and conquers the autumn Tenno Sho. She's congratulated on a great run by Tamamo Cross herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap also seems inspired, as she and Inari One make a passionate promise to race again at next year's autumn Tenno Sho.
